preconditions.description: The number of operations n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= i - 1 for i, k in enumerate(operations, start=1))
preconditions.description: For each operation, k must be between 0 and i-1, where i is the operation index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vj <= i - 1 and abs(xj) <= 1000000000 for i, op in enumerate(operations, start=1) for vj, xj in zip(op[1::2], op[2::2]))
preconditions.description: Each vertex index vj must be between 1 and i-1, and each weight xj must be between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the weights of all edges modulo 1000000007.
